name: SSH
label: SSH-2 exec / file transfer
description: SSH-2 session to a customer host: exec, download, upload. Handler SshNode (JSch). Keys are password-typed config only. Download/upload use type file (ref-id). known_hosts (content or fingerprint) is required — unknown or mismatched host keys are refused. ssh-rsa (SHA-1 signatures) is not offered; RFC 8332 rsa-sha2-256/512 or Ed25519.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One SSH operation. Purpose fields (host, command, remote_path, file) override config when set. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'exec'.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: exec | download | upload. Overrides config operation when set.

schema.label: host
schema.description: Remote hostname or IP for this invoke. Overrides config host when set.

schema.label: command
schema.description: Single remote command string for exec. Runs on the remote host only. Newlines rejected.

schema.label: remote_path
schema.description: Remote file path for download/upload. Path segment '..' is rejected.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref for upload (input). Type file. Never inline bytes on the wire.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Result file ref when the operation produces a file. Type file (platform ref-id). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: exec | download | upload. Required. Example: 'exec'.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: SSH password when auth_type=password. Password-typed config only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Private Key
configurationParameters.description: OpenSSH private key PEM when auth_type=key. Password-typed config only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Passphrase
configurationParameters.description: Passphrase for an encrypted private_key. Password-typed config only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Known Hosts
configurationParameters.description: OpenSSH known_hosts content or a host-key fingerprint (SHA256:… / MD5:…). Required. Unknown or mismatched host keys are refused. No trust-on-first-use. ssh-rsa (SHA-1) is not offered.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25, cap 60. Example: 25.
